messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — RIDIS_MAXCLIENTS on redis-prod-01 (service: redis-main) — severity: critical. Link: https://pd.example/INC12345

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Page triggered for service redis-main. Escalation policy: oncall-engineering. Assigned: sara.

sara: ack'd — looking. getting the error stream now. anyone seeing traffic spike?

mike: saw higher e2e inference spikes ~10:12 UTC, lots of short-lived connections. redis `maxclients` is at 10k, hitting limit.

julia: postgres also showing elevated wait/timeout metrics on app-db-primary. likely connection exhaustion cascading from connection pool.

sara: copying relevant logs: ```redis-cli -h redis-prod-01 INFO | grep connected_clients connected_clients:10002 # maxclients=10000```

alex: yep that's it. app layer pools not reusing connections properly for a subset of requests — suspect a recent runtime change.

sara: mitigation plan: 1) fail open some non-critical routes, 2) scale read-replicas/redis fallback group, 3) temporarily raise redis maxclients and restart if safe. prefer to avoid restart if we can shift traffic. any objections?

mike: +1 for shifting traffic. I can update routing to send low-priority inference to dedicated-durable cache cluster (redis-fallback-01) and enable prefix-KV cache on the inference gateway.

julia: i'll open a short-lived DB connection pool throttle to protect pg-primary — set pool_max=200 -> 120 for service A. That should reduce new connections.

sara: mike — can you run the routing change? provide command snippet here.

mike: running: ```kubectl set env deployment/inference-gateway -n prod REDIS_FALLBACK=redis-fallback-01 && kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-gateway -n prod``` will monitor. doing now.

incident-bot: Deployment inference-gateway restarted (rollout id: r-39823) — watching pods.

mike: routing change applied. seeing initial drop in connections to redis-prod-01 from ~10k -> 7k in 30s.

julia: DB pool throttle applied for service A. connection attempts queued, application returning 429 for overflowed requests (intentionally).

sara: customer impact: degraded latency for background inference and some customer requests hit transient 429s. No 5xx from core auth/payment flows. per-customer telemetry shows 2% affected of active requests in last 15m.

alex: found the root cause: a recent hotfix to the async client in runtimes changed keepalive behaviour, causing connections not to be reused for pooled clients. rolling back PR will fix.

sara: ok plan: keep routing fallback and pool throttle for 30m while we roll back runtime hotfix. mike, keep watch on redis connections; julia monitor DB latencies + errors. I'll notify support and update status page.

mike: redis connections steady ~6.8k, latency back to normal for high-priority traffic.

julia: pg p99 latency climbing slightly but stable, no new errors after throttle.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by sara; escalation paused.

sara: rolling back runtime hotfix now. ```git revert abc123 --no-edit && kubectl rollout restart deployment/runtimes -n prod```

incident-bot: runtimes rollout started (r-39824).

mike: runtimes pods back up. monitoring reuse metrics — connection reuse returning to baseline.

sara: verifying redis connected_clients: ```connected_clients:5200``` — good.

julia: DB connection usage back to normal. will keep throttles in place for 15 more minutes then remove if stable.

sara: support status update: short-lived degradation between 10:12-10:45 UTC, ~2% of requests got 429; root cause: runtime client keepalive regression causing connection churn and saturating redis and exhausting PG connection pools. mitigation: traffic reroute to redis-fallback, temporary DB pool throttles, rollback hotfix.

alex: postmortem action items: 1) add test for client keepalive behavior + connection reuse to CI, 2) add circuit-breaker in inference gateway for redis failures, 3) lower default redis maxclients safety margin and autoscale alerts, 4) instrument pool leaks by request path.

sara: pages clear. I'll hand back to regular rotation after 30m watch. thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident resolved (INC12345) — resolution note: traffic reroute + rollback.
__note: This document is a synthetic Slack thread for dataset generation. Messages are concatenated into a single string and prefixed by sender names per agents.md rules. All fields are strings or list of strings.
